heading: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Allotment, Status Check & Listing Date
tldr: Mahanadi Coalfields' IPO, valued at ₹8,981.12 crore, was subscribed 1.52 times, indicating moderate investor interest.
The allotment of shares for the initial public offering is expected to be finalised on November 25, 2026.
Investors can check their allotment status online through the websites of KFin Technologies, BSE, or NSE using their PAN number.
The shares of Mahanadi Coalfields are scheduled to be listed on the stock exchanges on November 27, 2026.
Successful applicants will see their allotted shares credited to their demat accounts, while others will receive refunds for their application amount.
